funds.heading: Funds or source of money
funds.meaning: The officer was not satisfied that you have enough money for the trip, or that the money's source is clear.
funds.fix: Show 6 months of statements with a steady balance, explain any large deposits with documents, and match funds to your income.

ties.heading: Ties to Pakistan
ties.meaning: The officer was not convinced you will return home after your visit.
ties.fix: Show job or business, family, property and other reasons that connect you to Pakistan, plus a clear return plan.

purpose.heading: Purpose of the trip
purpose.meaning: The officer was not clear about why you are travelling or whether it is a genuine visit.
purpose.fix: Give a clear day-by-day travel plan and a short cover letter explaining who, where, why and for how long.

credibility.heading: Credibility or inconsistent information
credibility.meaning: Some details did not match across your documents, or the officer doubted the information.
credibility.fix: Check every date, job title and amount for consistency. If the letter mentions deception, a ban or false documents, speak to a consultant or lawyer before doing anything.

history.heading: Previous travel or immigration history
history.meaning: Your past travel or earlier applications influenced the decision.
history.fix: Be honest about earlier refusals, explain what has changed, and show clean, consistent travel history where you have it.

documents.heading: Missing or insufficient documents
documents.meaning: The documents you sent did not prove what the application needed to show.
documents.fix: Use the official document list, add what was missing, and explain each document in the cover letter.

faqs.a: No. No honest consultant can — only the embassy decides. What we promise is a complete, consistent file and an honest opinion of your chances before you pay embassy fees.

faqs.q: How much bank balance do I need for a UK visit visa?
faqs.a: There is no fixed official amount. The officer checks that your funds cover the trip and match your income history. We review your statements in the free call.

faqs.q: I was refused before. Can you help?
faqs.a: Yes. Send us the refusal letter; we address every point raised and tell you honestly if it's better to wait.

faqs.q: I live outside Karachi. Can I still use Visafeast?
faqs.a: Yes. Consultations run on WhatsApp video or phone; you attend biometrics at your nearest VFS/visa centre.
Depends on the country and season; each country page shows the current official time with the date we last checked it.

faqs.q: Do you help with immigration and PR?
faqs.a: Yes — skilled, family and business pathways for Canada, Australia, the UK, USA, Germany, New Zealand and parts of Europe. Where the law requires a licensed representative, your case is filed with our licensed partners.

faqs.q: Can I read the website in my language?
faqs.a: Yes. The website opens in your country's language. You can switch at the top, and all languages are listed at the bottom.
